titles.de: Bundesgesetz über das Bankwesen (Bankwesengesetz – BWG)
titles.en: Federal Act on Banking (Banking Act)

payload.implementsNote: CRD IV, Directive 2013/36/EU; CRD5, Directive (EU) 2019/878; CRD6, Directive (EU) 2024/1619 (among the CELEX numbers the RIS title document lists for the act and its amending acts)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage banking risks with strategies and procedures proportionate to the business
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankwesengesetz (BWG), BGBl. Nr. 532/1993, § 39 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Manage banking risks with strategies and procedures proportionate to the business

summaries.en: The managers of a credit institution must apply the care of a prudent and conscientious manager, inform themselves of the risks of the banking business and operations, and steer, monitor and limit those risks through appropriate strategies and procedures. The institution must have administrative, accounting and control procedures for identifying, assessing, steering, limiting and monitoring those risks that are appropriate to the nature, scale and complexity of its banking business, including the risk of money laundering and terrorist financing and the risks of its remuneration policy.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep written compliance policies and, at a significant institution, an independent compliance function
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankwesengesetz (BWG), BGBl. Nr. 532/1993, § 39 Abs. 6, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep written compliance policies and, at a significant institution, an independent compliance function

summaries.en: A credit institution must set out in writing, update regularly and follow at all times policies and procedures designed to detect and minimise the risk that its management, supervisory board members and staff disregard the supervisory rules listed in § 69 Abs. 1. A credit institution of significant relevance must also set up a permanent, effective and independent compliance function with direct access to the management, led by a manager responsible only for that function who cannot be removed without the prior consent of the supervisory board.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply the remuneration principles to staff whose work materially affects the risk profile
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankwesengesetz (BWG), BGBl. Nr. 532/1993, § 39b Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Apply the remuneration principles to staff whose work materially affects the risk profile

summaries.en: When setting and applying its remuneration policy and practices, salaries and discretionary pension benefits included, for the categories of staff whose professional activities have a material impact on its risk profile, a credit institution must apply the principles in the annex to § 39b. It applies them in a way that is appropriate to its size, internal organisation and the nature, scale and complexity of its business and to the staff categories and their pay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run transparent and adequate procedures for handling complaints
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankwesengesetz (BWG), BGBl. Nr. 532/1993, § 39e, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Run transparent and adequate procedures for handling complaints

summaries.en: Credit institutions and financial institutions must set up transparent and adequate procedures for handling the complaints of their customers and business partners, so that recurring and potential legal and operational risks can be identified, analysed and remedied.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Control the outsourcing of material operational tasks and notify the FMA beforehand
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankwesengesetz (BWG), BGBl. Nr. 532/1993, § 25 Abs. 1, 3 und 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Control the outsourcing of material operational tasks and notify the FMA beforehand

summaries.en: A credit institution must have adequate staff at all times and, when it uses a service provider for material operational tasks of the bank, take the precautions set out in the annex to § 25. The outsourcing may not impair the quality of internal control or the authority's supervision, delegate the tasks of the management or change the institution's duties towards customers. The institution must notify the Financial Market Authority in writing of an intended outsourcing of material tasks before it concludes the agreement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Conclude transactions with managers, board members and related persons only with unanimous management approval and supervisory board consent
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankwesengesetz (BWG), BGBl. Nr. 532/1993, § 28 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Conclude transactions with managers, board members and related persons only with unanimous management approval and supervisory board consent

summaries.en: A credit institution may conclude legal transactions, directly or indirectly, with its managers, supervisory board members and the other persons the paragraph lists only on a unanimous decision of all managers and with the consent of the supervisory board, the person concerned having no vote. Small loans and transactions up to a quarter of annual pay and everyday banking business on market terms are exempt. Transactions with a company in which such a person is a manager, beneficial owner or member of a management body need the consent of the supervisory board.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain an internal audit that reports to all managers and quarterly to the supervisory board chair
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankwesengesetz (BWG), BGBl. Nr. 532/1993, § 42 Abs. 1 und 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Maintain an internal audit that reports to all managers and quarterly to the supervisory board chair

summaries.en: Credit institutions and financial institutions must set up an internal audit that answers directly to the managers and serves only the continuous and comprehensive review of the legality, propriety and expediency of the whole undertaking, equipped to fulfil its tasks. Decisions concerning the internal audit are taken by at least two managers jointly. It reports to all managers and, every quarter, on the audit areas and material findings to the chair of the supervisory board and to the audit committee.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep banking secrecy
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankwesengesetz (BWG), BGBl. Nr. 532/1993, § 38 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep banking secrecy

summaries.en: Credit institutions, their shareholders, members of their bodies, employees and other persons acting for them may not disclose or use secrets that were entrusted or made accessible to them solely on the basis of business relations with customers. The duty has no time limit, and applies subject to the exceptions the paragraph lists in Abs. 2.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify the FMA in writing without delay of changes in statutes, management and business
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankwesengesetz (BWG), BGBl. Nr. 532/1993, § 73 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Notify the FMA in writing without delay of changes in statutes, management and business

summaries.en: A credit institution must notify the Financial Market Authority in writing without delay of the events the paragraph lists, among them every change to its statutes, a resolution to dissolve, every change in the persons of its managers and in their fitness, and the opening, relocation, closure or temporary suspension of the head office's business. Where a resolution is involved it may not wait until the resolution takes effect.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give employees a confidential procedure for reporting breaches
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankwesengesetz (BWG), BGBl. Nr. 532/1993, § 99g Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Give employees a confidential procedure for reporting breaches

summaries.en: A credit institution must have adequate procedures that let its employees report internal breaches of the supervisory acts listed in § 70 Abs. 4, of regulations and decisions under them and of the Capital Requirements Regulation to a suitable body, with the confidentiality of their identity preserved.

titles.de: Bundesgesetz über die Sanierung und Abwicklung von Banken (Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz – BaSAG)
titles.en: Federal Act on the Recovery and Resolution of Banks (Recovery and Resolution Act)

payload.officialRef: Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (BaSAG), BGBl. I Nr. 98/2014
payload.implementsNote: BRRD, Directive 2014/59/EU (the CELEX number the RIS title document lists), as amended by Directive (EU) 2019/879 (§ 168 Abs. 1 of the act)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Draw up a recovery plan and keep it up to date
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (BaSAG), BGBl. I Nr. 98/2014, § 8 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Draw up a recovery plan and keep it up to date

summaries.en: Every institution established in Austria that is not part of a group under consolidated supervision must draw up a recovery plan and keep it up to date. The plan sets out the measures the institution would take to restore its financial stability after a significant deterioration of its financial situation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Update the recovery plan at least once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (BaSAG), BGBl. I Nr. 98/2014, § 11 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Update the recovery plan at least once a year

summaries.en: An institution must update its recovery plan at least once a year. The Financial Market Authority may order an update at shorter intervals.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Cooperate in resolution planning and give the resolution authority the information it asks for
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (BaSAG), BGBl. I Nr. 98/2014, § 21 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Cooperate in resolution planning and give the resolution authority the information it asks for

summaries.en: On the resolution authority's request an institution must cooperate as far as necessary in drawing up resolution plans and send the authority, directly or through the Financial Market Authority, all information needed to draw up and carry out the plans. The authority may in particular ask for the information and analyses listed in the annex to § 21.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Include a bail-in recognition clause in liabilities governed by third-country law
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (BaSAG), BGBl. I Nr. 98/2014, § 98 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Include a bail-in recognition clause in liabilities governed by third-country law

summaries.en: An institution must include in the agreement or instrument a contractual term by which the creditor or party recognises that the liability may be subject to the write-down and conversion powers and agrees to accept a reduction of the principal or outstanding amount, a conversion or a cancellation by a resolution authority. The duty covers liabilities that are not excluded from bail-in, are not deposits referred to in § 131 Abs. 1 and are governed by the law of a third country, on the conditions the paragraph lists.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Meet the minimum requirement for own funds and eligible liabilities at all times
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (BaSAG), BGBl. I Nr. 98/2014, § 100 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Meet the minimum requirement for own funds and eligible liabilities at all times

summaries.en: Every institution, and the holding companies the act covers, must meet the requirements for own funds and eligible liabilities at all times, as §§ 100 to 105c prescribe.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify the FMA in writing at once when the institution is failing or likely to fail
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (BaSAG), BGBl. I Nr. 98/2014, § 114 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Notify the FMA in writing at once when the institution is failing or likely to fail

summaries.en: Where the managers consider that an institution is failing or likely to fail within the meaning of § 51, they must notify the Financial Market Authority in writing without delay.

titles.en: Federal Act on Deposit Guarantee and Investor Compensation at Credit Institutions (Deposit Guarantee and Investor Compensation Act)

payload.officialRef: Einlagensicherungs- und Anlegerentschädigungsgesetz (ESAEG), BGBl. I Nr. 117/2015
payload.implementsNote: DGSD, Directive 2014/49/EU; Investor Compensation Schemes Directive, Directive 97/9/EC (the CELEX numbers the RIS title document lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Belong to a deposit guarantee scheme
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Einlagensicherungs- und Anlegerentschädigungsgesetz (ESAEG), BGBl. I Nr. 117/2015, § 8 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Belong to a deposit guarantee scheme

summaries.en: A CRR credit institution established in Austria that takes deposits must belong to the single protection scheme, unless it belongs to an institutional protection scheme recognised as a deposit guarantee scheme.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay the deposit guarantee contribution in the amount and by the date set
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Einlagensicherungs- und Anlegerentschädigungsgesetz (ESAEG), BGBl. I Nr. 117/2015, § 21 Abs. 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Pay the deposit guarantee contribution in the amount and by the date set

summaries.en: Every member institution must pay its contribution to the protection scheme in the amount set and by the date set.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report covered deposits to the scheme by 31 January each year
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Einlagensicherungs- und Anlegerentschädigungsgesetz (ESAEG), BGBl. I Nr. 117/2015, § 33 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report covered deposits to the scheme by 31 January each year

summaries.en: A member institution must tell its protection scheme by 31 January each year the total of its covered deposits as at 31 December of the previous year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the public which deposit guarantee scheme protects deposits, without advertising unlimited cover
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Einlagensicherungs- und Anlegerentschädigungsgesetz (ESAEG), BGBl. I Nr. 117/2015, § 38 Abs. 2 und 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Tell the public which deposit guarantee scheme protects deposits, without advertising unlimited cover

summaries.en: A member institution must inform the investing public, in the premises open to consumers or on its website, that it belongs to a deposit guarantee scheme and of the rules of the act that protect deposits, and also in the official languages of a member state where it takes deposits through a branch. In advertising the information may only refer to the scheme that protects the product and describe factually how it works, and may not refer to unlimited cover of deposits.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Belong to a protection scheme for investor compensation
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Einlagensicherungs- und Anlegerentschädigungsgesetz (ESAEG), BGBl. I Nr. 117/2015, § 45 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Belong to a protection scheme for investor compensation

summaries.en: A credit institution that provides investment services subject to protection must belong to the single protection scheme, unless it belongs to an institutional protection scheme that the act recognises.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell investors how investor compensation protects them
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Einlagensicherungs- und Anlegerentschädigungsgesetz (ESAEG), BGBl. I Nr. 117/2015, § 52, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Tell investors how investor compensation protects them

summaries.en: Credit institutions and the investment firms the paragraph names that provide protected investment services in Austria must inform the investing public, in the premises open to consumers or on their website, of the investor compensation rules of the act. Every investor must be handed written information in German, free of charge, when the business relationship starts and at the latest when the contract is concluded, describing the compensation scheme in a way that is easy to understand.

instruments.title: Add PfandBG, the Austrian covered bond act (Pfandbriefgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I Nr. 199/2021, title document (§ 0: long title, original gazette reference, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, last amended by BGBl. titles.de: Bundesgesetz über Pfandbriefe (Pfandbriefgesetz – PfandBG)
titles.en: Federal Act on Pfandbriefe (Covered Bond Act)

payload.implementsNote: Covered Bond Directive, Directive (EU) 2019/2162 (among the CELEX numbers the RIS title document lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep outstanding covered bonds covered at all times by cover assets of at least equal amount
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I Nr. 199/2021, § 9 Abs. 1 und 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep outstanding covered bonds covered at all times by cover assets of at least equal amount

summaries.en: The total amount of covered bonds in circulation must be covered at all times by cover assets of at least the same total amount. All liabilities of the covered bonds must be covered by claims for payment attached to the cover assets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Enter every cover asset, substitute asset and hedging transaction individually in the cover register
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I Nr. 199/2021, § 10 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Enter every cover asset, substitute asset and hedging transaction individually in the cover register

summaries.en: The credit institution must enter individually in a cover register the cover assets, substitute assets and hedging transactions that serve to cover the covered bonds and the claims of counterparties under derivative contracts in the cover pool. Where cover assets held by another credit institution are used, that institution is noted in the register.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a risk management unit for covered bonds that is independent of the operating business
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I Nr. 199/2021, § 18 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep a risk management unit for covered bonds that is independent of the operating business

summaries.en: Every credit institution that issues covered bonds must set up a risk management unit that is independent of the operating business and has direct access to the managers and to the chair of the supervisory board, to identify and monitor the risks of the covered bond business. The institution must give the unit sufficient staff and organisational resources.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold a cover pool liquidity buffer for the net outflows of the next 180 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I Nr. 199/2021, § 21 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Hold a cover pool liquidity buffer for the net outflows of the next 180 days

summaries.en: The credit institution must ensure that the cover pool at all times includes a liquidity buffer of eligible liquid assets available to cover the net liquidity outflow of the covered bond programme. The buffer must cover the maximum cumulative net liquidity outflow over the next 180 days.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish detailed information on covered bond programmes on the website every quarter
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I Nr. 199/2021, § 23 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Publish detailed information on covered bond programmes on the website every quarter

summaries.en: A credit institution that issues covered bonds must give investors detailed information on its covered bond programmes by publishing it on its website every quarter. The information covers the portfolio items the paragraph lists, among them the value of the cover pool and of the outstanding covered bonds, the list of ISINs, and the geographic distribution and type of the cover assets, their loan size and valuation method.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report on covered bond programmes to the FMA every quarter
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I Nr. 199/2021, § 29 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report on covered bond programmes to the FMA every quarter

summaries.en: The issuing credit institution must send the Financial Market Authority, after the end of each calendar quarter unless a longer interval is set and whenever the authority asks, the information on its covered bond programmes that the paragraph lists, including the underlying eligible cover assets, the cover assets located outside the Union and compliance with the rules on intragroup structures.

instruments.title: Add VKrG, the Austrian Consumer Credit Act of 2010 (Verbraucherkreditgesetz), repealed from 20 November 2026
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherkreditgesetz (VKrG), BGBl. titles.de: Bundesgesetz über Verbraucherkreditverträge und andere Formen der Kreditierung zu Gunsten von Verbrauchern (Verbraucherkreditgesetz – VKrG)
titles.en: Federal Act on Consumer Credit Agreements and Other Forms of Credit for Consumers (Consumer Credit Act)

payload.implementsNote: CCD, Directive 2008/48/EC (as § 1 of the act states)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Show standard information with a representative example in credit advertising that quotes rates or costs
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherkreditgesetz (VKrG), BGBl. I Nr. 28/2010, § 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Show standard information with a representative example in credit advertising that quotes rates or costs

summaries.en: Advertising for credit agreements that quotes an interest rate or other figures on the cost of the credit must show, clearly, concisely and prominently by means of a representative example, the borrowing rate with the costs included in the total cost of credit, the total amount of credit, the annual percentage rate of charge and, where applicable, the term, the total amount payable and the instalments. Where the lender requires an ancillary contract such as insurance whose cost cannot be determined in advance, the advertising must point to that obligation together with the annual percentage rate.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the consumer the standard European credit information in good time before the contract
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherkreditgesetz (VKrG), BGBl. I Nr. 28/2010, § 6 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Give the consumer the standard European credit information in good time before the contract

summaries.en: In good time before the consumer is bound by a credit agreement or an offer, the lender must give the consumer the information needed to compare offers and take an informed decision, covering the nineteen items the paragraph lists. The lender must use the form in Annex II of the act, the Standard European Consumer Credit Information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Check the consumer's creditworthiness before concluding the credit agreement and warn of doubts
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherkreditgesetz (VKrG), BGBl. I Nr. 28/2010, § 7 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Check the consumer's creditworthiness before concluding the credit agreement and warn of doubts

summaries.en: Before concluding a credit agreement the lender must check the consumer's creditworthiness on the basis of sufficient information, obtained from the consumer where needed and from an available database where necessary. Where the check gives rise to substantial doubts that the consumer can meet the obligations in full, the lender must tell the consumer of those doubts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Draw up the credit agreement on paper or another durable medium and give every party a copy
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherkreditgesetz (VKrG), BGBl. I Nr. 28/2010, § 9 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Draw up the credit agreement on paper or another durable medium and give every party a copy

summaries.en: A credit agreement must be drawn up on paper or on another durable medium, without this affecting the validity of the transaction. The lender must give every party to the contract a copy of the agreement without delay after it is concluded.

titles.de: Bundesgesetz über Verbraucherkreditverträge und andere Formen der Kreditierung zu Gunsten von Verbrauchern 2026 (Verbraucherkreditgesetz 2026 – VKrG 2026)
titles.en: Federal Act on Consumer Credit Agreements and Other Forms of Credit for Consumers 2026 (Consumer Credit Act 2026)

payload.implementsNote: CCD2, Directive (EU) 2023/2225 (as § 1 of the act states)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Grant no consumer credit without the consumer's prior request and express consent
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherkreditgesetz 2026 (VKrG 2026), BGBl. I Nr. 36/2026, § 7, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Grant no consumer credit without the consumer's prior request and express consent

summaries.en: A consumer credit may not be granted unless the consumer has asked for it beforehand and has expressly consented.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry a cost warning and standard information in credit advertising
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherkreditgesetz 2026 (VKrG 2026), BGBl. I Nr. 36/2026, § 8 Abs. 1, 2 und 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Carry a cost warning and standard information in credit advertising

summaries.en: Advertising for credit agreements must carry a clear and prominent warning that borrowing costs money. Where it quotes an interest rate or other cost figures it must also show, by a representative example, the borrowing rate with the costs included, the total amount of credit, the annual percentage rate of charge and, where applicable, the term, the total amount payable and the instalments. Advertising may not suggest that credit improves the consumer's financial situation or that existing credit has little or no effect on the assessment of an application.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the consumer the standard pre-contract information form in good time before the contract
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherkreditgesetz 2026 (VKrG 2026), BGBl. I Nr. 36/2026, § 10 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Give the consumer the standard pre-contract information form in good time before the contract

summaries.en: In good time before the consumer is bound by a credit agreement or an offer, the lender must give the consumer clear and comprehensible pre-contractual information for comparing offers and taking an informed decision. It must use the form in Annex I of the act, on paper or another durable medium of the consumer's choice, with the key items the paragraph lists shown prominently on one page in the first part of the form.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Explain the proposed credit and ancillary services so the consumer can judge whether they fit
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherkreditgesetz 2026 (VKrG 2026), BGBl. I Nr. 36/2026, § 12 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Explain the proposed credit and ancillary services so the consumer can judge whether they fit

summaries.en: The lender, and the credit intermediary where there is one, must give the consumer adequate explanations of the credit agreements and ancillary services on offer, free of charge and before the contract is concluded, so that the consumer can judge whether they suit the consumer's needs and financial situation. The explanations cover the pre-contractual information, the main features of the products, their specific effects on the consumer including the consequences of late payment or default, and whether each part of a bundle can be ended separately.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess the consumer's creditworthiness thoroughly and lend only where repayment is likely
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherkreditgesetz 2026 (VKrG 2026), BGBl. I Nr. 36/2026, § 17 Abs. 1, 2, 4 und 6, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Assess the consumer's creditworthiness thoroughly and lend only where repayment is likely

summaries.en: Before concluding a credit agreement the lender must assess the consumer's creditworthiness thoroughly, on relevant and accurate information about income, expenses and other financial circumstances that is proportionate to the credit and contains no special categories of personal data. The lender may make the credit available only where the assessment shows that the consumer is likely to meet the obligations as agreed. It must set, document and keep its assessment procedures and keep the information it relied on.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Draw up the credit agreement and any change to it on a durable medium and give every party a copy
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherkreditgesetz 2026 (VKrG 2026), BGBl. I Nr. 36/2026, § 20 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Draw up the credit agreement and any change to it on a durable medium and give every party a copy

summaries.en: Credit agreements and any changes to them must be drawn up on paper or on another durable medium, without this affecting the validity of the transaction. The lender must give every party to the contract a copy of the agreement without delay after it is concluded.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Show reasonable forbearance before starting enforcement and refer struggling consumers to debt advice
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherkreditgesetz 2026 (VKrG 2026), BGBl. I Nr. 36/2026, § 31 Abs. 1 und 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Show reasonable forbearance before starting enforcement and refer struggling consumers to debt advice

summaries.en: A lender must exercise reasonable forbearance, as the case requires and with regard to the consumer's individual circumstances, before it starts enforcement proceedings. It must refer consumers who have difficulty meeting their financial obligations to debt advisory services that are easy for them to reach.

titles.en: Federal Act on Mortgage and Real Estate Credit Agreements and Other Credit for Consumers (Mortgage and Real Estate Credit Act)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Show the standard information with a representative example in mortgage credit advertising
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Hypothekar- und Immobilienkreditgesetz (HIKrG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2015, § 6 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Show the standard information with a representative example in mortgage credit advertising

summaries.en: Advertising for credit agreements that quotes an interest rate or other figures on the cost of the credit must show the standard information the paragraph lists clearly, concisely and prominently, including a warning, where relevant, that exchange rate movements can change the amount the consumer pays. Most of that information must be illustrated by a representative example that matches the advertised type of contract.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep clear general information on mortgage credit agreements available at all times
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Hypothekar- und Immobilienkreditgesetz (HIKrG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2015, § 7, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep clear general information on mortgage credit agreements available at all times

summaries.en: Lenders, and tied credit intermediaries where there are any, must make clear and comprehensible general information on their credit agreements available at all times, on paper, on another durable medium or in electronic form. It covers at least the items the paragraph lists, among them the ancillary services the consumer must buy and a general warning of the consequences of not meeting the obligations under the agreement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the consumer personalised pre-contract information on the ESIS
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Hypothekar- und Immobilienkreditgesetz (HIKrG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2015, § 8 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Give the consumer personalised pre-contract information on the ESIS

summaries.en: The lender must give the consumer personalised information for comparing the credit products on the market, weighing their effects and taking an informed decision. It is given on paper or another durable medium by means of the European Standardised Information Sheet in Annex II, without delay once the consumer has provided the information on needs, financial situation and preferences, and in good time before the consumer is bound by a credit agreement or an offer.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess creditworthiness thoroughly and grant the credit only where repayment is likely
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Hypothekar- und Immobilienkreditgesetz (HIKrG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2015, § 9 Abs. 1 bis 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Assess creditworthiness thoroughly and grant the credit only where repayment is likely

summaries.en: Before concluding a credit agreement the lender must assess the consumer's creditworthiness thoroughly, on necessary, sufficient and proportionate information about income, expenses and other financial circumstances. The assessment may not rest mainly on the value of the property exceeding the credit or on an expected rise in that value, unless the credit serves to build or renovate the property, and the lender must set, document and keep the procedures and information it relies on. The credit may be granted only where the assessment shows that the obligations are likely to be met as the agreement requires.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send a binding offer on a durable medium with the draft contract and keep it open for at least seven days
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Hypothekar- und Immobilienkreditgesetz (HIKrG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2015, § 12 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Send a binding offer on a durable medium with the draft contract and keep it open for at least seven days

summaries.en: A binding offer must be sent to the consumer on paper or another durable medium, together with a copy of the draft credit agreement, and with an ESIS where none was given before or where the offer differs from the one given. The offer must stay binding on the lender for at least seven days.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not tie the credit agreement to other financial products
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Hypothekar- und Immobilienkreditgesetz (HIKrG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2015, § 23 Abs. 2 bis 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Do not tie the credit agreement to other financial products

summaries.en: A lender may not offer or conclude a credit agreement only in a package with other separate financial products or services, apart from the cases the paragraph allows, such as an account that serves only to repay or secure the credit or a pension product that also serves as security. The lender may require relevant insurance, but must accept a policy from another provider that gives equivalent cover.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Let the consumer convert a foreign currency credit and warn of exchange rate moves above 20 per cent
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Hypothekar- und Immobilienkreditgesetz (HIKrG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2015, § 24 Abs. 2 und 6, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Let the consumer convert a foreign currency credit and warn of exchange rate moves above 20 per cent

summaries.en: For a foreign currency credit the lender must let the consumer convert the agreement into an alternative currency at each quarter end on fourteen days' notice, or on other dates of at least the same number set in the agreement. The lender must warn the consumer on paper or another durable medium, regularly and at least when the total amount still payable or the instalments differ by more than 20 per cent from what they would be at the exchange rate that applied when the agreement was concluded.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the consumer a fee information document before the payment account contract
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherzahlungskontogesetz (VZKG), BGBl. I Nr. 35/2016, § 6 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Give the consumer a fee information document before the payment account contract

summaries.en: In good time before a consumer is bound by a framework contract or an offer, the payment service provider must give the consumer a fee information document showing the fees for the most representative services linked to a payment account that it offers. The document is a short stand-alone document in the standard EU format, given on paper or, where the consumer agrees, on another durable medium together with the pre-contractual information under the payment services act.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the consumer a statement of fees at least once a year and when the contract ends
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherzahlungskontogesetz (VZKG), BGBl. I Nr. 35/2016, § 8 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Give the consumer a statement of fees at least once a year and when the contract ends

summaries.en: The payment service provider must give or make available to the consumer, at least once a year and when the framework contract ends, a statement of fees. It shows at least the unit fee charged for each service and the number of times it was used, the fees for any package, the total fees incurred in the period, and where applicable the overdraft and credit interest rates and the total interest charged and earned.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As receiving provider, complete the account switching steps within five business days
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherzahlungskontogesetz (VZKG), BGBl. I Nr. 35/2016, § 18 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: As receiving provider, complete the account switching steps within five business days

summaries.en: Within five business days of receiving the information it requested from the transferring provider, the receiving payment service provider must, where the consumer's authorisation provides for it and as far as the information allows, set up the standing orders the consumer wants, make the arrangements to accept direct debits, and tell the payers and payees named in the authorisation the details of the new account. It also informs the consumer of the rights to limit, check or block direct debits.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As transferring provider, send the account information within five business days and close the account on the agreed date
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherzahlungskontogesetz (VZKG), BGBl. I Nr. 35/2016, § 17 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: As transferring provider, send the account information within five business days and close the account on the agreed date

summaries.en: Where the consumer's authorisation provides for it, the transferring payment service provider must, on the receiving provider's request, send the requested information within five business days. From the date named in the authorisation it stops accepting incoming credit transfers and direct debits unless it redirects them, cancels the standing orders, transfers the remaining positive balance and closes the account once the consumer has no outstanding obligations on it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Open a basic payment account for any consumer lawfully resident in the EU within ten business days
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherzahlungskontogesetz (VZKG), BGBl. I Nr. 35/2016, § 23 Abs. 1, 4 und 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Open a basic payment account for any consumer lawfully resident in the EU within ten business days

summaries.en: Every consumer lawfully resident in the European Union may open and use a payment account with basic features at a credit institution established in Austria. A credit institution that offers payment accounts to consumers in Austria may refuse the application only on a ground listed in § 24 Abs. 1, and must open the account or refuse the application without delay and at the latest ten business days after the complete application arrives.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Charge no more than the capped annual fee for a basic payment account
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherzahlungskontogesetz (VZKG), BGBl. I Nr. 35/2016, § 26 Abs. 1 und 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Charge no more than the capped annual fee for a basic payment account

summaries.en: For a payment account with basic features, the fee agreed with the consumer for the services listed in § 25 Abs. 1 may not exceed 80 euros a year. The amount is adjusted every two years in line with the consumer price index and published in the Bundesgesetzblatt.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Terminate a basic payment account only on the grounds the act lists
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbraucherzahlungskontogesetz (VZKG), BGBl. I Nr. 35/2016, § 27 Abs. 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Terminate a basic payment account only on the grounds the act lists

summaries.en: A credit institution may unilaterally terminate a framework contract for a payment account with basic features only where at least one of the listed conditions is met. They include deliberate use of the account for unlawful purposes, no transaction for more than 24 consecutive months, incorrect information given to obtain the account, loss of lawful residence in the Union and the opening of a second payment account in Austria.

titles.de: Wertpapieraufsichtsgesetz 2018 – WAG 2018
titles.en: Securities Supervision Act 2018

payload.implementsNote: MiFID II, Directive 2014/65/EU, and Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2017/593 (as § 114a Abs. 1 of the act states)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set policies and procedures that ensure compliance and keep conflicts of interest from harming clients
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wertpapieraufsichtsgesetz 2018 (WAG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 29 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Set policies and procedures that ensure compliance and keep conflicts of interest from harming clients

summaries.en: A firm must set adequate policies and procedures to ensure that it, its management, its employees and its tied agents comply with the act and with the organisational requirements and operating conditions of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/565. It must keep effective organisational and administrative arrangements at all times for taking reasonable steps to prevent conflicts of interest from harming clients' interests.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Approve each financial instrument through a product approval process before it is marketed
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wertpapieraufsichtsgesetz 2018 (WAG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 30 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Approve each financial instrument through a product approval process before it is marketed

summaries.en: A firm that manufactures financial instruments for sale to clients must maintain, operate and review a process for approving each financial instrument, and each significant adaptation of an existing one, before it is marketed or distributed to clients. It meets the product governance requirements in a way that is appropriate and proportionate to the instrument, the investment service and the product's target market.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep records of all services and transactions, including recorded calls and electronic communications
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wertpapieraufsichtsgesetz 2018 (WAG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 33 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep records of all services and transactions, including recorded calls and electronic communications

summaries.en: A firm must keep records of all its services, activities and transactions that are sufficient for the Financial Market Authority to supervise it and to check that it has met its obligations, including those towards clients and for the integrity of the market. The records must include recordings of telephone conversations and electronic communications at least for transactions concluded when dealing on own account and for services relating to the reception, transmission and execution of client orders, also where the conversation does not lead to a transaction.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Safeguard clients' financial instruments and funds
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wertpapieraufsichtsgesetz 2018 (WAG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 38 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Safeguard clients' financial instruments and funds

summaries.en: A firm that holds financial instruments belonging to clients must make adequate arrangements, in particular for its insolvency, to safeguard the clients' ownership rights and to prevent the instruments from being used for its own account without the client's express consent. A firm that holds clients' funds must make adequate arrangements to safeguard the clients' rights and, unless it is a credit institution, to prevent the funds from being used for its own account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify and prevent or manage conflicts of interest with and between clients
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wertpapieraufsichtsgesetz 2018 (WAG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 45, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Identify and prevent or manage conflicts of interest with and between clients

summaries.en: A firm must take appropriate steps to identify and to prevent or manage conflicts of interest between itself, relevant persons, tied agents or persons linked to it by control and its clients, or between one client and another, that arise in providing investment services, investment activities and ancillary services. This includes conflicts caused by receiving benefits from third parties or by the firm's own remuneration structure.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Disclose a conflict of interest to the client where the arrangements cannot prevent harm
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wertpapieraufsichtsgesetz 2018 (WAG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 46, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Disclose a conflict of interest to the client where the arrangements cannot prevent harm

summaries.en: Where a firm's procedures and measures are not sufficient to ensure with reasonable confidence that the risk of damage to client interests is avoided, it must disclose to the client the general nature and the sources of the conflicts of interest and the steps taken to limit those risks before it undertakes business for the client. The disclosure is made on a durable medium.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay or accept no third-party benefits unless the act allows them
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wertpapieraufsichtsgesetz 2018 (WAG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 51 Abs. 2 und 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Pay or accept no third-party benefits unless the act allows them

summaries.en: A firm does not act in its clients' best interests, and breaches its conflicts duty, if in connection with an investment or ancillary service it pays a fee, commission or non-monetary benefit to, or accepts one from, anyone other than the client or a person acting on the client's behalf. Such benefits are permitted only under the conditions the paragraph sets out in Abs. 3.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain the client's knowledge, financial situation and objectives and recommend only what is suitable
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wertpapieraufsichtsgesetz 2018 (WAG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 56 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Obtain the client's knowledge, financial situation and objectives and recommend only what is suitable

summaries.en: A firm that provides investment advice or portfolio management must obtain information on the client's knowledge and experience in the investment field relevant to the specific type of product or service, the client's financial situation including the ability to bear losses, and the client's investment objectives including risk tolerance. It does so in order to recommend the services and financial instruments that are suitable for the client and match the client's risk tolerance and ability to bear losses.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess whether a non-advised product or service is appropriate for the client and warn where it is not
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wertpapieraufsichtsgesetz 2018 (WAG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 57 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Assess whether a non-advised product or service is appropriate for the client and warn where it is not

summaries.en: When providing investment services other than advice and portfolio management, a firm must ask the client for information on knowledge and experience in the investment field relevant to the specific type of product or service offered or demanded, so that it can assess whether it is appropriate for the client. Where the firm concludes on that information that the product or service is not appropriate, it must warn the client, which it may do in a standardised format.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Take all sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result when executing client orders
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wertpapieraufsichtsgesetz 2018 (WAG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 62 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Take all sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result when executing client orders

summaries.en: When executing orders a firm must take all sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result for its clients, taking into account price, costs, speed, likelihood of execution and settlement, size, nature and any other consideration relevant to the execution. Where the client gives a specific instruction, the firm must execute the order following that instruction.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Instruct staff on the insider dealing ban and keep internal rules on the passing on of information
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Börsegesetz 2018 (BörseG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 119 Abs. 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Instruct staff on the insider dealing ban and keep internal rules on the passing on of information

summaries.en: To prevent insider dealing, the issuers the paragraph names and every credit institution, insurance and reinsurance undertaking and pension fund must inform their employees and other persons working for them of the ban on the misuse of inside information. They must issue internal guidelines on passing on information within the undertaking and monitor compliance with them, and take suitable organisational measures to prevent the misuse or improper disclosure of inside information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the FMA and the exchange of inside information before publishing it
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Börsegesetz 2018 (BörseG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 119 Abs. 6, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Tell the FMA and the exchange of inside information before publishing it

summaries.en: Every issuer of securities admitted to the regulated market must notify the Financial Market Authority and the exchange operating company of the facts it has to publish under Article 17 of the Market Abuse Regulation before it publishes them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish the annual financial report within four months of the year end
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Börsegesetz 2018 (BörseG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 124 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Publish the annual financial report within four months of the year end

summaries.en: An issuer must publish its annual financial report at the latest four months after the end of each financial year and ensure that it stays publicly available for at least ten years. The report comprises the audited accounts, the management report and the responsibility statements of the issuer's legal representatives.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish the half-year financial report within three months of the period end
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Börsegesetz 2018 (BörseG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 125 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Publish the half-year financial report within three months of the period end

summaries.en: An issuer of shares or debt securities must publish a half-year financial report on the first six months of the financial year without delay and at the latest three months after the end of that period, and ensure that it stays publicly available for at least ten years. The report comprises condensed accounts, an interim management report and the responsibility statements of the issuer's legal representatives.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify changes in major holdings of voting rights within two trading days
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Börsegesetz 2018 (BörseG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 130 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Notify changes in major holdings of voting rights within two trading days

summaries.en: A person who directly or indirectly acquires or disposes of shares of an issuer whose home member state is Austria and whose shares are admitted to trading on a regulated market must inform the Financial Market Authority, the exchange operating company and the issuer without delay, and at the latest after two trading days, of the proportion of voting rights held where it reaches, exceeds or falls below one of the thresholds from 4 per cent to 90 per cent that the paragraph lists. An issuer may add a threshold of 3 per cent in its articles.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give employees a confidential procedure for reporting market abuse and exchange law breaches
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Börsegesetz 2018 (BörseG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 107/2017, § 159 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Give employees a confidential procedure for reporting market abuse and exchange law breaches

summaries.en: An employer supervised by the Financial Market Authority must have adequate procedures that let its employees report internal breaches of the act, of regulations and decisions under it and of the Market Abuse Regulation to a suitable body, with the confidentiality of their identity preserved.

obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Investmentfondsgesetz 2011 (InvFG 2011), BGBl. I Nr. 77/2011, § 10 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep documented decision-making, internal controls and records in the management company

summaries.en: A management company must set up, apply and maintain decision-making procedures and an organisational structure that clearly specify and document reporting lines and allocate functions and responsibilities. It must make sure that the relevant persons know the procedures they have to follow, keep adequate internal control mechanisms and internal reporting at all relevant levels, and keep adequate and orderly records of its business and internal organisation, all in proportion to the nature, scale and complexity of its business.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep compliance policies and a permanent, independent compliance function
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Investmentfondsgesetz 2011 (InvFG 2011), BGBl. I Nr. 77/2011, § 15 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep compliance policies and a permanent, independent compliance function

summaries.en: A management company must establish, apply and maintain adequate policies and procedures designed to detect any risk that it fails to meet its obligations under the act and the EU regulations adopted under the UCITS Directive, and adequate measures to keep that risk to a minimum. It must set up a permanent, effective and independent compliance function that monitors and regularly assesses those measures and advises and assists the persons responsible for the company's services and activities.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a permanent risk management function independent of the operating units
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Investmentfondsgesetz 2011 (InvFG 2011), BGBl. I Nr. 77/2011, § 17 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep a permanent risk management function independent of the operating units

summaries.en: A management company must set up a permanent risk management function that is hierarchically and functionally independent of the operating units, as far as this is appropriate and proportionate to the nature, scale and complexity of its business and of the UCITS it manages.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Treat the unit holders of managed funds equally
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Investmentfondsgesetz 2011 (InvFG 2011), BGBl. I Nr. 77/2011, § 29 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Treat the unit holders of managed funds equally

summaries.en: A management company must treat the unit holders of the UCITS it manages equally and may not place the interests of one group of unit holders above those of another.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint a single depositary bank for each fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Investmentfondsgesetz 2011 (InvFG 2011), BGBl. I Nr. 77/2011, § 40 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Appoint a single depositary bank for each fund

summaries.en: A management company must entrust the safekeeping of the securities belonging to a UCITS, and the keeping of the fund's accounts, to a single depositary bank that meets the requirements of § 41.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As depositary, ensure that units are issued, redeemed and valued as the act and the fund rules require
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Investmentfondsgesetz 2011 (InvFG 2011), BGBl. I Nr. 77/2011, § 40 Abs. 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: As depositary, ensure that units are issued, redeemed and valued as the act and the fund rules require

summaries.en: The depositary bank must ensure that the sale, issue, redemption, payment and cancellation of units and the calculation of the unit value are carried out in accordance with the act and the fund rules and in the unit holders' interest. It must also ensure that the consideration for transactions involving the fund's assets is remitted to it without delay and that the fund's income is applied as the act and the fund rules require.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act honestly, with due skill and care, and in the best interests of the funds and their investors
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Gesetz (AIFMG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2013, § 10 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Act honestly, with due skill and care, and in the best interests of the funds and their investors

summaries.en: An alternative investment fund manager must at all times act honestly and fairly, with due skill, care and diligence, and in the best interests of the funds it manages or their investors and of the integrity of the market. It must have and use effectively the resources and procedures its business needs, take all reasonable steps to avoid conflicts of interest or to identify, manage, monitor and where applicable disclose them, and treat the investors of its funds equally unless the fund's rules provide for preferential treatment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set a remuneration policy for staff whose work materially affects the risk profile
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Gesetz (AIFMG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2013, § 11 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Set a remuneration policy for staff whose work materially affects the risk profile

summaries.en: A manager must set a remuneration policy and practice for the categories of staff whose professional activities have a material impact on its risk profile or on those of the funds it manages, including managers, risk takers, control functions and staff in the same pay bracket.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify conflicts of interest and keep arrangements that prevent them from harming funds and investors
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Gesetz (AIFMG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2013, § 12 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Identify conflicts of interest and keep arrangements that prevent them from harming funds and investors

summaries.en: A manager must take all reasonable steps to identify the conflicts of interest that arise in managing funds between itself, its staff or persons linked to it by control and a fund or its investors, and between one fund, investor or client and another. It must maintain effective organisational and administrative arrangements for identifying, preventing, managing and monitoring conflicts so that they do not harm the funds and their investors, and must separate tasks and responsibilities that may be regarded as incompatible.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Separate risk management from the operating units and run adequate risk management systems
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Gesetz (AIFMG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2013, § 13 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Separate risk management from the operating units and run adequate risk management systems

summaries.en: A manager must separate the functions of risk management functionally and hierarchically from the operating units and be able to show the Financial Market Authority on request that safeguards against conflicts of interest allow risk management to act independently. It must use adequate risk management systems to identify, measure, manage and monitor all risks relevant to each fund's investment strategy, and may not rely solely and mechanically on credit ratings when assessing the creditworthiness of a fund's assets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a liquidity management system with regular stress tests for each fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Gesetz (AIFMG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2013, § 14 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Run a liquidity management system with regular stress tests for each fund

summaries.en: For each fund it manages that is not an unleveraged closed-ended fund, a manager must have an adequate liquidity management system and procedures that let it monitor the fund's liquidity risk and ensure that the liquidity profile of the investments matches the fund's underlying obligations. It must conduct stress tests regularly, under normal and exceptional liquidity conditions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure that a single depositary is appointed for each fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Gesetz (AIFMG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2013, § 19 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Ensure that a single depositary is appointed for each fund

summaries.en: For each alternative investment fund it manages, the manager must ensure that a single depositary is appointed in accordance with § 19.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Produce an annual report for each fund within six months of the financial year end
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Gesetz (AIFMG), BGBl. I Nr. 135/2013, § 20 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Produce an annual report for each fund within six months of the financial year end

summaries.en: A manager must produce an annual report for each EU fund it manages and each fund it markets in the Union for every financial year, no later than six months after the end of that year. The report is sent to investors on request and made available to the Financial Market Authority within the same period.

titles.de: Bundesgesetz über die Erbringung von Zahlungsdiensten 2018 (Zahlungsdienstegesetz 2018 – ZaDiG 2018)
titles.en: Federal Act on the Provision of Payment Services 2018 (Payment Services Act 2018)

payload.implementsNote: PSD2, Directive (EU) 2015/2366 (as § 117a Abs. 1 of the act states)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Safeguard the funds received from payment service users
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungsdienstegesetz 2018 (ZaDiG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 17/2018, § 18 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Safeguard the funds received from payment service users

summaries.en: Payment institutions, and the e-money institutions the paragraph names, must safeguard all funds received from payment service users or through another provider for the execution of payment transactions in one of two ways. Either the funds are never mixed with those of other persons and, if still held at the end of the business day after receipt, are placed in a separate trust account at a credit institution or central bank or invested in safe, liquid, low-risk assets, or they are covered by an insurance policy or comparable guarantee from an insurer or credit institution outside the institution's group.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep documented sound governance with risk and control procedures
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungsdienstegesetz 2018 (ZaDiG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 17/2018, § 20 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep documented sound governance with risk and control procedures

summaries.en: A payment institution must have sound governance and document it in writing in a way that can be followed. It includes an organisational structure with clearly delimited, coherent and transparent responsibilities that avoids conflicts of interest and of competence, and administrative, accounting and control procedures for identifying, assessing, steering, monitoring and reporting the risks of its payment services business and its remuneration policy. The managers must apply the care of a prudent and conscientious manager and steer, monitor and limit those risks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the user the information and terms of the framework contract
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungsdienstegesetz 2018 (ZaDiG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 17/2018, § 48 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Give the user the information and terms of the framework contract

summaries.en: The payment service provider must give the payment service user the information and contract terms the paragraph lists, starting with the provider's name, address, supervisory authority and register entry.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Propose changes to the framework contract at least two months before they apply
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungsdienstegesetz 2018 (ZaDiG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 17/2018, § 50 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Propose changes to the framework contract at least two months before they apply

summaries.en: The payment service provider must propose changes to the framework contract to the payment service user at the latest two months before the proposed date of their application, in the manner laid down for the prior information. Where it has been agreed that silence counts as consent, the provider must point out that the user is deemed to have accepted unless the user notifies a refusal before that date.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refund an unauthorised payment by the end of the following business day
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungsdienstegesetz 2018 (ZaDiG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 17/2018, § 67 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Refund an unauthorised payment by the end of the following business day

summaries.en: Where a payment transaction was not authorised, the payer's payment service provider must refund the amount to the payer without delay and at the latest by the end of the business day after it learned of the transaction or was notified of it. It must restore the debited payment account to the state it would have been in without the transaction.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Credit the payee's provider by the end of the business day after receipt of the payment order
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungsdienstegesetz 2018 (ZaDiG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 17/2018, § 77 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Credit the payee's provider by the end of the business day after receipt of the payment order

summaries.en: The payer's payment service provider must ensure that the amount of the payment transaction is credited to the account of the payee's payment service provider at the latest by the end of the business day following the time of receipt of the order. For transactions initiated on paper the period is one business day longer.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a framework of mitigation measures and controls for operational and security risks
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungsdienstegesetz 2018 (ZaDiG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 17/2018, § 85 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep a framework of mitigation measures and controls for operational and security risks

summaries.en: A payment service provider must set up a framework of appropriate mitigation measures and control mechanisms to manage the operational and security risks of the payment services it provides. As part of it the provider must establish and apply effective incident management procedures, including for the detection and classification of major operational and security incidents.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Require strong customer authentication for online account access and electronic payments
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungsdienstegesetz 2018 (ZaDiG 2018), BGBl. I Nr. 17/2018, § 87 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Require strong customer authentication for online account access and electronic payments

summaries.en: A payment service provider must require strong customer authentication where the payer accesses the payment account online, initiates an electronic payment transaction or carries out any action through a remote channel that carries a risk of payment fraud or other abuse. For electronic remote payment transactions the authentication must include elements that dynamically link the transaction to a specific amount and a specific payee.

titles.en: Federal Act on the Issuance of Electronic Money and the Taking Up, Pursuit and Supervision of the Business of Electronic Money Institutions (E-Money Act 2010)
