obligations.title: Add the duty: Safeguard the funds received for e-money and for payment services
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), E-Geldgesetz 2010, BGBl. I Nr. 107/2010, § 12 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Safeguard the funds received for e-money and for payment services

summaries.en: An e-money institution must safeguard the funds it has received for issuing e-money, and those received for executing payment transactions in payment services not linked to e-money, in one of the two ways set out in § 18 of the Payment Services Act 2018. The Financial Market Authority may prescribe one of the two methods after hearing the institution.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply the governance, outsourcing, record and internal audit rules for payment institutions
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), E-Geldgesetz 2010, BGBl. I Nr. 107/2010, § 13 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Apply the governance, outsourcing, record and internal audit rules for payment institutions

summaries.en: An e-money institution must meet the governance, outsourcing, record-keeping and reporting requirements of §§ 20, 21, 24 and 26 of the Payment Services Act 2018, and § 36 and the internal audit rules of § 42 of the Banking Act, with regard to the risks of both its payment services and its e-money business.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Issue e-money at par value for the funds received
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), E-Geldgesetz 2010, BGBl. I Nr. 107/2010, § 17, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Issue e-money at par value for the funds received

summaries.en: An e-money issuer must always issue e-money at the par value of the funds it has received. Contract terms that depart from this to the detriment of e-money holders are void.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Redeem e-money at par value whenever the holder asks
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), E-Geldgesetz 2010, BGBl. I Nr. 107/2010, § 18 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Redeem e-money at par value whenever the holder asks

summaries.en: An e-money issuer must redeem the monetary value of the e-money held, at par value and at any time, when the holder asks. Contract terms that depart from this to the detriment of e-money holders are void, and duties under other laws or official orders to block a payment instrument or freeze funds are unaffected.

obligations.title: Add the duty: State the redemption conditions in the contract and charge a fee only where the act allows
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), E-Geldgesetz 2010, BGBl. I Nr. 107/2010, § 19 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: State the redemption conditions in the contract and charge a fee only where the act allows

summaries.en: The conditions of redemption, including any fees, must be stated clearly and prominently in the contract, and the issuer must tell the holder of them in good time before the holder is bound. A redemption fee may be charged only where the holder asks for redemption before the contract ends, ends a fixed-term contract early, or asks for redemption more than one year after the contract has ended, and only if it was agreed, is proportionate and reflects the issuer's actual costs.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Grant no interest or other benefit for the time e-money is held
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), E-Geldgesetz 2010, BGBl. I Nr. 107/2010, § 20, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Grant no interest or other benefit for the time e-money is held

summaries.en: An issuer may not grant interest or any other benefit related to the length of time during which a holder holds the e-money.

titles.en: Federal Act on the Operation and Supervision of Contract Insurance (Insurance Supervision Act 2016)

payload.implementsNote: Solvency II, Directive 2009/138/EC; IDD, Directive (EU) 2016/97 (among the CELEX numbers the RIS title document lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an effective system of governance and review it regularly
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz 2016 (VAG 2016), BGBl. I Nr. 34/2015, § 107 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep an effective system of governance and review it regularly

summaries.en: An insurance or reinsurance undertaking must set up an effective system of governance that provides for sound and prudent management and is proportionate to the nature, scale and complexity of its business, and must review it internally at regular intervals. The system ensures at least an adequate and transparent organisational structure with a clear allocation and appropriate segregation of responsibilities, an effective system for transmitting information, and compliance with the rules on the governance functions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an effective risk management system
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz 2016 (VAG 2016), BGBl. I Nr. 34/2015, § 110 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep an effective risk management system

summaries.en: An insurance or reinsurance undertaking must set up an effective risk management system with the strategies, processes and reporting procedures needed to identify, measure, monitor, manage and report, on an individual and an aggregated basis, the risks it is or could be exposed to and their interdependencies.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out an own risk and solvency assessment
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz 2016 (VAG 2016), BGBl. I Nr. 34/2015, § 111 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Carry out an own risk and solvency assessment

summaries.en: As part of its risk management system an insurance or reinsurance undertaking must conduct its own risk and solvency assessment, which is an integral part of the business strategy and feeds into strategic decisions. It covers at least the overall solvency needs given the specific risk profile, approved risk tolerance limits and business strategy, continuous compliance with the capital requirements and the rules on technical provisions, and the significance of any deviation of the risk profile from the assumptions underlying the solvency capital requirement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Stay responsible for outsourced functions and notify critical outsourcing to the FMA beforehand
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz 2016 (VAG 2016), BGBl. I Nr. 34/2015, § 109 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Stay responsible for outsourced functions and notify critical outsourcing to the FMA beforehand

summaries.en: An insurance or reinsurance undertaking that outsources functions or activities to a service provider remains responsible for meeting all supervisory requirements and must ensure that the provider cooperates with the Financial Market Authority, that the undertaking, its auditors and the authority have effective access to the provider's data on the outsourced functions, and that the authority has effective access to the provider's premises. Contracts that outsource critical or important operational functions or activities must be notified to the authority in good time before the outsourcing, and need its prior approval where the provider is not an insurance or reinsurance undertaking.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a product approval process for each new or significantly changed insurance product
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz 2016 (VAG 2016), BGBl. I Nr. 34/2015, § 129 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Run a product approval process for each new or significantly changed insurance product

summaries.en: An insurance undertaking must maintain, operate and regularly review internal processes for designing and approving each new insurance product and each significant change to an existing one, and for the proper distribution and regular review of the products it designs. The processes must be proportionate and appropriate to the nature of the insurance product.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the policyholder a personal recommendation before the contract unless advice is waived
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz 2016 (VAG 2016), BGBl. I Nr. 34/2015, § 132 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Give the policyholder a personal recommendation before the contract unless advice is waived

summaries.en: Before the policyholder makes the contractual declaration for a direct insurance contract covering a risk situated in Austria, other than a large risk, the insurance undertaking must give a personal recommendation that explains why the recommended contract best meets the policyholder's demands and needs. The duty does not apply where the policyholder wants a particular contract and, after a warning, verifiably waives advice in a separate declaration, and the undertaking may not induce a customer to waive advice.

titles.de: Bundesgesetz zur Verhinderung der Geldwäscherei und Terrorismusfinanzierung im Finanzmarkt (Finanzmarkt-Geldwäschegesetz – FM-GwG)
titles.en: Federal Act on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing in the Financial Market (Financial Markets Anti-Money Laundering Act)

payload.implementsNote: AMLD4, Directive (EU) 2015/849 (the CELEX number the RIS title document lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify and assess the firm's money laundering, terrorist financing and sanctions evasion risks
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Finanzmarkt-Geldwäschegesetz (FM-GwG), BGBl. I Nr. 118/2016, § 4 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Identify and assess the firm's money laundering, terrorist financing and sanctions evasion risks

summaries.en: An obliged entity must identify and assess the potential risks of money laundering and terrorist financing, and of the non-implementation and evasion of targeted financial sanctions, to which its business is exposed. It does so on the basis of data and information and with regard to all relevant risk factors, in particular customers, countries or geographic areas, products, services, transactions, delivery channels and new or developing technologies.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify and verify the customer and the beneficial owner and monitor the relationship
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Finanzmarkt-Geldwäschegesetz (FM-GwG), BGBl. I Nr. 118/2016, § 6 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Identify and verify the customer and the beneficial owner and monitor the relationship

summaries.en: Customer due diligence comprises identifying the customer and verifying the identity from a reliable and independent source, identifying the beneficial owner and taking reasonable measures to verify that identity and to understand the ownership and control structure, and obtaining information on the purpose and intended nature of the relationship and on the source of the funds. It also comprises ongoing monitoring of the relationship and its transactions and regular review and updating of the information held. Anyone who claims to act for the customer is identified and the authority to act is checked.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply enhanced due diligence where the risk is higher
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Finanzmarkt-Geldwäschegesetz (FM-GwG), BGBl. I Nr. 118/2016, § 9 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Apply enhanced due diligence where the risk is higher

summaries.en: In the cases named in §§ 9a to 12, and wherever an obliged entity finds from its risk analysis or otherwise that there is a higher risk of money laundering or terrorist financing, it must apply enhanced customer due diligence to manage and mitigate those risks appropriately.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Detect politically exposed persons and apply the additional measures to them
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Finanzmarkt-Geldwäschegesetz (FM-GwG), BGBl. I Nr. 118/2016, § 11 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Detect politically exposed persons and apply the additional measures to them

summaries.en: In addition to customer due diligence, an obliged entity must have adequate risk management systems, with risk-based procedures applied before the relationship starts and at regular intervals afterwards, to establish whether the customer, the beneficial owner or the settlor is a politically exposed person. For relationships with such persons it must obtain senior management approval before establishing or continuing the relationship, take adequate measures to establish the source of wealth and of funds, and conduct enhanced ongoing monitoring.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report suspicions to the financial intelligence unit without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Finanzmarkt-Geldwäschegesetz (FM-GwG), BGBl. I Nr. 118/2016, § 16 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report suspicions to the financial intelligence unit without delay

summaries.en: An obliged entity must inform the financial intelligence unit (Geldwäschemeldestelle) of its own accord and without delay by a suspicious activity report where it knows, suspects or has reasonable grounds to assume that a transaction or an asset is connected with proceeds of the offences listed in § 165 of the Criminal Code, with a criminal organisation, a terrorist group or offence or terrorist financing, or that the customer has breached the duty to disclose a trustee relationship. The report is sent in a common electronic format through the secure channels the unit has set.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Stop processing a reported transaction and follow the financial intelligence unit's instructions
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Finanzmarkt-Geldwäschegesetz (FM-GwG), BGBl. I Nr. 118/2016, § 17 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Stop processing a reported transaction and follow the financial intelligence unit's instructions

summaries.en: After submitting a suspicious activity report, an obliged entity must refrain from any further processing of the transactions concerned and follow all further specific instructions of the financial intelligence unit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep suspicious activity reports and related steps secret from customers and third parties
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Finanzmarkt-Geldwäschegesetz (FM-GwG), BGBl. I Nr. 118/2016, § 20 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep suspicious activity reports and related steps secret from customers and third parties

summaries.en: An obliged entity must keep everything done in fulfilment of the reporting and non-execution duties secret from customers and third parties. Where it has a reportable suspicion and can reasonably assume that carrying out customer due diligence would hinder the pursuit of the beneficiaries of a suspicious transaction, it must suspend the due diligence and instead inform the financial intelligence unit at once by a suspicious activity report.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep due diligence documents and transaction records for ten years
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Finanzmarkt-Geldwäschegesetz (FM-GwG), BGBl. I Nr. 118/2016, § 21 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep due diligence documents and transaction records for ten years

summaries.en: An obliged entity must keep copies of the documents and information needed to meet customer due diligence, and the transaction records needed to trace transactions, for ten years after the end of the business relationship with the customer or after an occasional transaction.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set anti-money-laundering policies, procedures and controls and appoint a special officer
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Finanzmarkt-Geldwäschegesetz (FM-GwG), BGBl. I Nr. 118/2016, § 23 Abs. 1 und 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Set anti-money-laundering policies, procedures and controls and appoint a special officer

summaries.en: An obliged entity must set up policies, procedures and controls, proportionate to its nature and size, to mitigate and manage effectively the money laundering and terrorist financing risks identified at Union, national and firm level, covering among other things customer risk classification, due diligence, suspicious reports and record keeping. It must appoint a special officer to ensure compliance with the act, who is responsible only to the management body, reports to it directly and has free access to all relevant information, data, records and systems.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Observe targeted financial sanctions and set controls against their non-implementation and evasion
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Finanzmarkt-Geldwäschegesetz (FM-GwG), BGBl. I Nr. 118/2016, § 23a Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Observe targeted financial sanctions and set controls against their non-implementation and evasion

summaries.en: An obliged entity must observe targeted financial sanctions and set up policies, procedures and controls to mitigate and manage the risk that they are not implemented or are evaded. They cover in particular the firm-level risk analysis, measures to detect risk factors and possible signs of evasion, risk management systems, and the notification and reporting duties connected with targeted financial sanctions.

titles.de: Bundesgesetz über die Einrichtung eines Registers der wirtschaftlichen Eigentümer von Gesellschaften, anderen juristischen Personen und Trusts (Wirtschaftliche Eigentümer Registergesetz – WiEReG)
titles.en: Federal Act on the Establishment of a Register of Beneficial Owners of Companies, Other Legal Entities and Trusts (Beneficial Owners Register Act)

payload.officialRef: Wirtschaftliche Eigentümer Registergesetz (WiEReG), BGBl. I Nr. 136/2017
payload.implementsNote: AMLD4, Directive (EU) 2015/849, and Directive (EU) 2016/2258 (the CELEX numbers the RIS title document lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify and verify the entity's own beneficial owners at least once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wirtschaftliche Eigentümer Registergesetz (WiEReG), BGBl. I Nr. 136/2017, § 3 Abs. 1 und 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Identify and verify the entity's own beneficial owners at least once a year

summaries.en: A legal entity must establish the identity of its beneficial owner and take reasonable measures to verify it, so that it is satisfied it knows who its beneficial owner is, including measures to understand its ownership and control structure and any relevant nominee arrangements. It must carry out this due diligence at least once a year, obtaining adequate, accurate and current information, and check whether the beneficial owners reported to the register are still up to date.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the documents on beneficial ownership for at least five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wirtschaftliche Eigentümer Registergesetz (WiEReG), BGBl. I Nr. 136/2017, § 3 Abs. 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep the documents on beneficial ownership for at least five years

summaries.en: A legal entity must keep copies of the documents and information needed for the due diligence on its beneficial owners until at least five years after the natural person's beneficial ownership has ended. Sending a complete compliance package for the entity to the register counts as meeting this duty.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report beneficial owners and nominee arrangements to the register within four weeks
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wirtschaftliche Eigentümer Registergesetz (WiEReG), BGBl. I Nr. 136/2017, § 5 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report beneficial owners and nominee arrangements to the register within four weeks

summaries.en: A legal entity must report the data on its beneficial owners and nominee arrangements that the paragraph lists to Statistik Österreich, which processes them for the register authority. The data are sent within four weeks of the entity's first entry in its base register or of the end of an exemption from reporting, and changes within four weeks of the entity learning of them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not rely on the register alone when identifying a customer's beneficial owners
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wirtschaftliche Eigentümer Registergesetz (WiEReG), BGBl. I Nr. 136/2017, § 11 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Do not rely on the register alone when identifying a customer's beneficial owners

summaries.en: An obliged entity may not rely exclusively on the register's information on a legal entity's beneficial owners when it applies customer due diligence and must follow a risk-based approach. A register extract may be used to establish the beneficial owners but not to verify them, except that a complete extended extract may serve for verification where there are no factors of higher risk and the entity has confirmed with its customer that no other control or trustee relationships exist.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Flag register entries on a customer's beneficial owners that are found to be wrong or incomplete
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Wirtschaftliche Eigentümer Registergesetz (WiEReG), BGBl. I Nr. 136/2017, § 11 Abs. 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Flag register entries on a customer's beneficial owners that are found to be wrong or incomplete

summaries.en: Where an obliged entity finds in its customer due diligence that the beneficial owners or nominee arrangements entered in the register for a customer differ from those it has established, and is satisfied that the register entry is incorrect or incomplete, it must set a remark electronically through the Unternehmensserviceportal and give its reasons in standard form. The duty falls away where the customer corrects the entry within a reasonable time after being told, and no remark may be set where the matter must be reported to the financial intelligence unit.

instruments.title: Add SanktG 2024, the Austrian Sanctions Act 2024 (Sanktionengesetz 2024)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Sanktionengesetz 2024 (SanktG 2024), BGBl. I Nr. 5/2025, title document (§ 0: long title, original gazette reference, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, last amended by BGBl. titles.de: Bundesgesetz über Sanktionsmaßnahmen (Sanktionengesetz 2024 – SanktG 2024)
titles.en: Federal Act on Sanctions Measures (Sanctions Act 2024)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set written strategies, controls and procedures for complying with sanctions
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Sanktionengesetz 2024 (SanktG 2024), BGBl. I Nr. 5/2025, § 7, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Set written strategies, controls and procedures for complying with sanctions

summaries.en: A financial market participant, meaning a credit institution, a financial institution or a crypto-asset service provider under the FM-GwG, must set out in writing strategies, controls and procedures for complying effectively with Austrian sanctions measures and directly applicable EU sanctions, proportionate to its nature and size. A management body must approve them, put them in place, adapt them where needed and apply them continuously. A firm that is part of a group must ensure they are applied at individual and group level.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Credit and freeze incoming funds for a sanctioned person and notify the FMA at once
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Sanktionengesetz 2024 (SanktG 2024), BGBl. I Nr. 5/2025, § 5 Abs. 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Credit and freeze incoming funds for a sanctioned person and notify the FMA at once

summaries.en: A financial market participant must credit incoming amounts that third parties have ordered for a person or entity covered by an Austrian sanctions measure and freeze those amounts as well. It must notify the Financial Market Authority of the receipt without delay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the assets of sanctioned persons and entities to the FMA
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Sanktionengesetz 2024 (SanktG 2024), BGBl. I Nr. 5/2025, § 12 Abs. 8, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report the assets of sanctioned persons and entities to the FMA

summaries.en: A financial market participant must report to the Financial Market Authority the assets of persons and entities that are covered by an Austrian sanctions measure or by directly applicable EU sanctions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Release frozen assets or make assets available only with a permit
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Sanktionengesetz 2024 (SanktG 2024), BGBl. I Nr. 5/2025, § 5 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Release frozen assets or make assets available only with a permit

summaries.en: Assets frozen under an Austrian sanctions measure may be released, and assets made available to a sanctioned person, only where this is approved in the individual case on a reasoned application for one of the purposes the act lists, such as basic needs, legal fees or the costs of keeping the frozen assets. Under § 6 of the act the Financial Market Authority decides applications that concern assets a financial market participant holds or manages or claims against it.

instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Datenschutzgesetz (DSG), BGBl. titles.de: Bundesgesetz zum Schutz natürlicher Personen bei der Verarbeitung personenbezogener Daten (Datenschutzgesetz – DSG)
titles.en: Federal Act on the Protection of Natural Persons with regard to the Processing of Personal Data (Data Protection Act)

payload.implementsNote: Supplements GDPR, Regulation (EU) 2016/679, as § 4 Abs. 1 of the act states

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep personal data confidential (data secrecy)
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Datenschutzgesetz (DSG), BGBl. I Nr. 165/1999, § 6 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep personal data confidential (data secrecy)

summaries.en: The controller, the processor and their employees must keep confidential the personal data from data processing that were entrusted or became accessible to them solely because of their professional occupation, unless there is a legally permitted ground for transmitting them. This applies without prejudice to other statutory confidentiality duties.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Bind employees to transmit personal data only on instruction and instruct them on data secrecy
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Datenschutzgesetz (DSG), BGBl. I Nr. 165/1999, § 6 Abs. 2 und 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Bind employees to transmit personal data only on instruction and instruct them on data secrecy

summaries.en: Employees may transmit personal data only on the express instruction of their employer. Unless they are already bound by law, the controller and the processor must bind their employees by contract to transmit personal data only on instruction and to keep data secrecy after the employment ends, and must instruct them on the transmission instructions that apply to them and on the consequences of breaching data secrecy.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record images only on one of the lawful grounds and never to monitor employees
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Datenschutzgesetz (DSG), BGBl. I Nr. 165/1999, § 12 Abs. 2 und 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Record images only on one of the lawful grounds and never to monitor employees

summaries.en: An image recording is permitted only where it is necessary in the vital interest of a person, the data subject has consented, a special statutory provision orders or allows it, or overriding legitimate interests of the controller or a third party exist in the individual case and it is proportionate. Recording to monitor employees, recording in a person's most private sphere without express consent, automated matching with other personal data to build personality profiles, and evaluation by special categories of personal data are not permitted.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Secure image recordings, log each processing operation and delete recordings no longer needed
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Datenschutzgesetz (DSG), BGBl. I Nr. 165/1999, § 13 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Secure image recordings, log each processing operation and delete recordings no longer needed

summaries.en: The controller of an image recording must take data security measures appropriate to the risk and ensure that unauthorised persons cannot access or later alter the recording, and must log every processing operation except in real-time monitoring. Recorded personal data must be deleted when no longer needed for their purpose and no other statutory retention duty applies, and keeping them longer than 72 hours must be proportionate and separately logged and justified.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Mark image recording so that the controller is clearly identified
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Datenschutzgesetz (DSG), BGBl. I Nr. 165/1999, § 13 Abs. 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Mark image recording so that the controller is clearly identified

summaries.en: The controller of an image recording must mark it suitably. The marking must clearly show who the controller is, unless the data subjects already know this from the circumstances.

instruments.title: Add GMSG, the Austrian Common Reporting Standard Act (Gemeinsamer Meldestandard-Gesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Gemeinsamer Meldestandard-Gesetz (GMSG), BGBl. titles.de: Bundesgesetz zur Umsetzung des gemeinsamen Meldestandards für den automatischen Austausch von Informationen über Finanzkonten (Gemeinsamer Meldestandard-Gesetz – GMSG)
titles.en: Federal Act Implementing the Common Reporting Standard for the Automatic Exchange of Financial Account Information (Common Reporting Standard Act)

payload.implementsNote: DAC, Directive 2011/16/EU, as amended (as § 1 Abs. 1 of the act states)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register as a reporting financial institution with the tax office
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Gemeinsamer Meldestandard-Gesetz (GMSG), BGBl. I Nr. 116/2015, § 1a, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Register as a reporting financial institution with the tax office

summaries.en: Every reporting financial institution must register electronically with the competent tax office of its own accord, within one month of starting its activity or, if it was already reporting on 31 December 2025, by 31 March 2026. It must deregister electronically within one month after its licence lapses or its liquidation is completed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the required information on every reportable account to the tax office
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Gemeinsamer Meldestandard-Gesetz (GMSG), BGBl. I Nr. 116/2015, § 3 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report the required information on every reportable account to the tax office

summaries.en: Subject to the exemptions in § 6, every reporting financial institution reports to the competent tax office, for each of its reportable accounts, the information the paragraph lists, starting with the name and address of each reportable person who is an account holder.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the report electronically by the end of July, including a nil report
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Gemeinsamer Meldestandard-Gesetz (GMSG), BGBl. I Nr. 116/2015, § 4 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the report electronically by the end of July, including a nil report

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution must send its report by the end of July of each calendar year for the preceding reporting period, and must do so electronically. It must also file a report where it held no reportable accounts in the period, as a nil report.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Establish and record the reportable information for all account holders
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Gemeinsamer Meldestandard-Gesetz (GMSG), BGBl. I Nr. 116/2015, § 5 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Establish and record the reportable information for all account holders

summaries.en: Every reporting financial institution must establish, record, store and process the information named in § 3 and § 12 for all account holders and other customers, for all existing and all new accounts, whether or not the account holder or customer is a reportable person.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell each person concerned before the first report that the information goes to the tax office
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Gemeinsamer Meldestandard-Gesetz (GMSG), BGBl. I Nr. 116/2015, § 5 Abs. 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Tell each person concerned before the first report that the information goes to the tax office

summaries.en: Before it first sends information to the competent tax office, every reporting financial institution must tell each person concerned in general terms, or make it accessible to them, that the information established under the act is sent to the tax office as far as the act requires.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the due diligence documents for seven years
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Gemeinsamer Meldestandard-Gesetz (GMSG), BGBl. I Nr. 116/2015, § 7a, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep the due diligence documents for seven years

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution must keep the documents and information needed to meet the due diligence duties of the act until seven years after the end of the reporting period to which they relate.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain a tax residence self-certification when an individual opens an account
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Gemeinsamer Meldestandard-Gesetz (GMSG), BGBl. I Nr. 116/2015, § 30 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Obtain a tax residence self-certification when an individual opens an account

summaries.en: For new accounts of individuals the reporting financial institution must obtain a self-certification at account opening that lets it establish the account holder's residence or residences for tax purposes. It must confirm that the self-certification is plausible on the basis of the information obtained when the account was opened, including documents collected under anti-money-laundering procedures.
